person: Farah Siddiqui, senior accountant at Brightwell & Lowe LLP, lives in Maplecroft, Toronto, and is planning her wedding to Tomás Ferreira

mail.subject: Walkthrough and next payment
mail.body: Hi Farah and Tomás, lovely to hear from you. I've booked your venue walkthrough for Friday the week after next, early evening. Please park in the rear lot and bring your draft floor plan. As a reminder, your second deposit of $4,500 is due four weeks from tomorrow, and the final headcount is due 30 days before the wedding. Warmly, Celeste, The Juniper Hall

mail.subject: Northgate fieldwork
mail.body: Farah, Northgate fieldwork is next Thursday and Friday at their Wexford Ave office. I need the revenue testing done by Friday noon so I can review it before the weekend. Parking is validated at the front desk. Gordon

mail.subject: Tasting confirmed
mail.body: Hi Farah, your tasting is confirmed for Sunday after next. You'll try six mains and choose three. The $60 tasting fee will be credited to your final invoice. Please bring your guests' dietary list so we can plan around it. Ravi, Saffron & Sage Catering

mail.subject: Contract signed + engagement shoot
mail.body: Thanks for signing! Your engagement shoot is set for two weeks from this Saturday at Willowmere Park. Bring two outfits. Your package total is $3,400; the second instalment of $1,200 is due by the end of next week. Ingrid, Lumen & Lark Photography

mail.subject: RSVP
mail.body: Farah beta, we got the save-the-date! Uncle Imran and I will both be there, so count us as 2. Please remember Imran has a severe tree-nut allergy, the caterer must know. Love, Khala

mail.subject: Consultation booked
mail.body: Hi Farah, your consultation is booked for Tuesday after next, after work. Please bring colour swatches and any inspiration photos. For 14 tables plus a ceremony arch, couples in your style usually spend between $2,800 and $3,600. Mei Lin, Petal & Thorn

mail.subject: Plus one?
mail.body: Hi lovely! Quick q, is my invite a plus-one? I might bring Theo. And is brunch at Bluebird this Sunday still on?

mail.subject: Your bill is ready
mail.body: Your Lakeshore Hydro bill is $96.40, due in 18 days. Account 7731-0042.

mail.subject: Second fitting
mail.body: Hi Farah, your second fitting is booked for Thursday after next. Please bring the shoes and the undergarments you plan to wear on the day. The alteration balance of $420 is due at your final fitting. Sofia, Ivory Lane Bridal

mail.subject: the wedding
mail.body: Farah api, so sorry, I'm on a work posting overseas until the autumn so I can't make the wedding. I'll send a gift! Zain

mail.subject: Your DJ quote
mail.body: Hi Farah, here's your quote: 6 hours of DJ and MC for $1,850 plus HST, uplighting $250 extra. I can hold your date for 7 days from today; after that it's released to the next couple. Kofi, Northwind Sound

mail.subject: Cake tasting
mail.body: Hi Farah, I've booked you in for a tasting two weeks from today at lunchtime. Flavours: lemon elderflower, chai, dark chocolate cherry and pistachio rose. Tasting fee $40. A three-tier cake for 130 starts at $780. Bram, Sugarloaf Bakery

mail.subject: budget update
mail.body: Updated the spreadsheet: we've committed $41,300 of our $45,000. Can we try to cap flowers at $2,500? Also Mum wants to add four of her cousins, she'll email you the names. T x

mail.subject: the four names
mail.body: Querida Farah, Tomás said it's ok to add my cousins. The four names are Ilda and Rui Moreira, Fernanda Lopes and Paulo Lopes. Rui is vegetarian. Beijinhos, Graça

mail.subject: Save the date!
mail.body: Congratulations you two! Yes, we'll definitely be there. Can we bring baby Tolu? She'll be about 14 months by then.

mail.subject: Trial booked
mail.body: Hi Farah, your hair and makeup trial is booked for two weeks from tomorrow, in the morning. Please come with clean, dry hair and bring photos of your dress and a few looks you like. The trial fee is $150, deducted from your wedding-day package. Anika, Glow Studio

mail.subject: shower + dresses
mail.body: Thinking the bridal shower three weeks from Saturday at Marco's mum's place, 2pm. Also bridesmaid dresses: sage or dusty blue? Hannah and Noor need to order soon, so vote by Friday! And don't forget you're at ours for dinner next Saturday x

mail.subject: Our call and the licence
mail.body: Hello Farah and Tomás, I'm looking forward to our call two weeks from tomorrow in the evening. I've attached a draft ceremony outline. Please note the marriage licence must be in my hands at least two weeks before the wedding. Marguerite

mail.subject: Room block confirmed
mail.body: Your room block is confirmed: 15 rooms at $189 per night plus tax. Guests should book with group code FERREIRA-SIDDIQUI. Unbooked rooms are released six weeks from today.

mail.subject: recs
mail.body: Hi Farah, could you review my bank reconciliations for Pinecrest before the Northgate fieldwork starts on Thursday? They're in the shared folder under Q3. Thanks! P

mail.subject: Booking confirmed KQ7M2X
mail.body: Booking KQ7M2X: Toronto to Isla Corvina, 2 passengers, seats 14A and 14B. Total paid $2,318.60. One checked bag each included.

mail.subject: Reservation CSR-77310
mail.body: Thank you for booking 7 nights in an Ocean Suite. Your deposit of $900 has been received. The balance of $3,150 is due 60 days before arrival. Ask us about our honeymoon package.

mail.subject: plus one?
mail.body: Hey Farah! Got the save-the-date, so exciting. Would it be ok if I brought my partner Min-ji? Totally fine if not.

mail.subject: Q3 review time
mail.body: Hi Farah, could we push tomorrow's Q3 review to 3:30? Same link. Our controller is stuck in a board meeting. Erin

mail.subject: Building notices
mail.body: Fire alarm testing this Thursday from 9 to 4, expect short alarms. The water will be shut off next Tuesday from 10am to 2pm for valve work.

mail.subject: Your invitation proof is ready
mail.body: Hi Farah, your invitation proof is ready to view. Please approve it within 3 days to keep your print slot; after that, the next slot is three weeks out. Order: 120 invitations with RSVP cards, $640 plus tax.

mail.subject: Benefits enrolment closes soon
mail.body: Annual benefits enrolment closes in 10 days. If you're getting married, you can add your spouse once you have the marriage certificate.

mail.subject: Class pack running low
mail.body: You have 2 classes left in your 10-class pack. It expires in 3 weeks. Top up this week and save 15%.

mail.subject: Saturday
mail.body: Looking forward to Saturday! It's paella night, so bring nothing but your appetite. Street parking is free in the evening.

mail.subject: See you Friday
mail.body: Hi both, see you Friday! Please bring the floor plan and your guest count estimate. The chandelier room is being repainted, so we'll meet in the garden room instead.

mail.subject: Quote for 130 guests
mail.body: Following up: at 130 guests the per-head price is $118, plus 13% HST and an 18% service charge. We'll lock in the menu at your tasting. Please send the dietary list before then.

mail.subject: Your statement is ready
mail.body: Your statement balance is $2,184.55. The minimum payment of $65.00 is due in 15 days.

mail.subject: Offsite logistics
mail.body: Hi all, the shuttle to the year-end offsite leaves the office at 7:45am sharp. Breakfast is on the bus. Dress is business casual.

mail.subject: Order LL-55821 has shipped
mail.body: Your order of 14 sage linen table runners ($312.00) has shipped and should arrive on Monday.

mail.subject: Delivered
mail.body: Your parcel from Ivory Lane Bridal was delivered to the concierge desk at 10:52 this morning.

mail.subject: PD hours reminder
mail.body: You've logged 14 of the 20 verifiable PD hours required this year. Hours must be entered by the end of next month.

mail.subject: Shoot day tips
mail.body: Getting excited for your shoot! Avoid busy patterns and bring a blanket for the sitting shots. If it rains we'll move to the conservatory at the north end of the park.

mail.subject: flowers + tomorrow
mail.body: Petal & Thorn's range is way over our $2,500 cap. Can we ask Mei Lin about using more greenery? Also my work party tomorrow is cocktail attire, sorry for the late notice! T

mail.subject: Re: Plus one?
mail.body: Totally understand about no plus-ones, Theo's fine with it! Thanks for brunch on Sunday. Did you and Leila pick a dress colour yet?

mail.subject: Appointments booked
mail.body: Your next two appointments with Dr. Mehta are booked. Sessions are $95 each and are direct-billed to your benefits plan. You've used $570 of your $750 annual physio coverage.
